mcqs.q: When 81 staff classified the same four surrender narratives, what did agreement on surrender reason look like?
o: Near-perfect agreement on a single reason
12-16 unique reasons selected per scenario (low agreement)
mcqs.e: Out of 40 possible reasons, 12-16 unique reasons were chosen per scenario, indicating low consistency.

mcqs.q: Agreement among staff for breed and color entry was characterized as:
mcqs.e: Agreement was also low for breed and color.

mcqs.q: What did the authors conclude about using shelter software data for management decisions?
o: Data are reliable as currently entered
Further research is needed to collect data consistently
mcqs.e: They concluded further research is required for consistent, meaningful data collection.

mcqs.q: In the Washington, DC cat data, what was the most common intake type?
mcqs.e: Most intakes were stray cats at 59%.

mcqs.q: Where were the highest numbers of cat intakes concentrated?
mcqs.e: Highest intakes came from high-development, low-income neighborhoods.

mcqs.q: Seized cats predominantly originated from:
mcqs.e: Seized cats originated from low-income neighborhoods.

mcqs.q: Which dog characteristics were associated with LONGER time to adoption in this Polish shelter dataset?
o: Male, mixed-breed, dark fur, large, older
mcqs.e: Male sex, mixed-breed, dark fur, large size, and older age predicted longer LOS.

mcqs.q: Which modeling approach did the authors conclude is preferable for studying LOS factors?
mcqs.e: They concluded the accelerated failure time model is preferable for time-dependent LOS factors.

mcqs.q: What post features influenced public engagement with adoptable-animal Facebook posts?
o: Only the posting time of day
Type of animal (dog vs cat) and depicted environment
mcqs.e: Type of animal and environment (e.g., home vs other) influenced likes and shares.

mcqs.q: How did engagement differ between Fall 2019 (pre-pandemic) and Fall 2020 (pandemic)?
o: 2019 posts had more likes; 2020 posts had more shares
2020 posts had more likes; 2019 more shares
2019 had both more likes and shares
mcqs.e: Fall 2019 posts had more likes while Fall 2020 posts had more shares.

mcqs.q: Regarding Social Vulnerability Index (SVI), animals tended to ENTER shelters from:
mcqs.e: Animals tended to enter shelters from higher-vulnerability areas.

mcqs.q: How were adoptions distributed across SVI levels?
mcqs.e: Adoptions were evenly distributed across SVI levels, suggesting equitable access.

mcqs.q: Were animals from high-SVI areas euthanized at higher rates?
mcqs.e: Animals from high-SVI areas were not euthanized at higher rates than those from lower-SVI areas.

mcqs.q: Among 2836 relinquishment records, the single most frequent reason was:
mcqs.e: Behavior issues were cited most often at 28%.

mcqs.q: The most common behavioral reason for surrender was:
mcqs.e: Aggression was the leading behavioral reason at 32%.

mcqs.q: Which relinquishment category increased significantly in 2022-2023?
mcqs.e: The 'Unable to Care' category rose significantly in 2022 and 2023.

mcqs.q: In this Australian study, the primary reason for relinquishment was:
mcqs.e: Housing issues at 31.2% were the leading reason.

mcqs.q: The median ages of relinquished cats and dogs were:
mcqs.e: Median age was 5 months for cats and 16 months for dogs.

mcqs.q: Financial difficulties as a relinquishment reason were more common among:
mcqs.e: Financial difficulties were more common in lower (decile 1-5) vs higher SES groups.

mcqs.q: As household income increased, the likelihood of acquiring a dog through friends and family:
mcqs.e: Acquiring via friends/family decreased monotonically as income rose, while adopting/purchasing increased.

mcqs.q: Compared with someone earning under USD 15,000, a person earning over USD 100,000 was:
o: Less likely to surrender to a shelter
More than four times likelier to surrender to a shelter
mcqs.e: High earners were >4x likelier to surrender to a shelter than low earners.

mcqs.q: The authors suggest shelters could best help by:
o: Supporting low-income owners to keep dogs in their community of care
mcqs.e: Supporting low-income owners keeps dogs within their community and out of the shelter system.

mcqs.q: What measurable effect did Solliquin have on dogs entering the shelter?
o: Increased only the light-rest activity category
mcqs.e: The only significant change was increased light rest (P = 0.050).

mcqs.q: What was Solliquin's effect on fecal cortisol and most other parameters?
mcqs.e: No effects were seen on fecal cortisol or other parameters including deep rest.

mcqs.q: In the impossible-task test, treated dogs showed what change during solvable phases?
o: Significantly decreased time to solve the task
mcqs.e: DiRelax-treated dogs solved solvable phases significantly faster.

mcqs.q: Bloodwork (CBC and chemistry) in treated dogs indicated:
o: No difference between groups, supporting safety
mcqs.e: No group differences in bloodwork suggested the product is safe.

mcqs.q: During the unsolvable phase, treated vs untreated anxious dogs showed:
mcqs.e: No behavioral difference was found during the unsolvable phase.

mcqs.q: Exogenous corticosteroids in dogs have been associated with which behavioral changes?
o: Increased aggression and barking with decreased play
mcqs.e: Corticosteroids increased aggression/barking and decreased play and exploratory behaviors.

mcqs.q: Corticosteroids were described as biasing canine sensitivity toward:
mcqs.e: Corticosteroids can bias sensitivity toward aversion in dogs.

mcqs.q: By analogy to humans, which dogs may be most at risk of corticosteroid behavioral side effects?
mcqs.e: As with humans with psychiatric disorders, dogs with pre-existing behavioral problems may be most at risk.

mcqs.q: Compared with placebo, dogs given trazodone before a veterinary visit had:
mcqs.e: Trazodone-treated dogs had lower mean DSS by owner and video assessment.

mcqs.q: What was trazodone's effect on serum cortisol concentrations?
mcqs.e: No meaningful differences were observed in serum cortisol.

mcqs.q: The clinical relevance reported was that a single pre-transport trazodone dose:
o: Reduced signs of stress during veterinary visits
mcqs.e: A single dose reduced stress signs and may improve exam quality and welfare.
